class.name: MaszynaVehicleMmdManager
class.brief_description: The vehicles' MMD data, each type's read once.
class.description: What a vehicle type's [code].mmd[/code] says it is built from, in a skin - and of the vehicle itself when its MMD names [code](p1)[/code], the vehicle's own name - kept on disk: a scenery repeats the same type across its trainsets. An entry is read again when its [code].mmd[/code] or [code].fiz[/code] changes (their own modification times; the FIZ's for the pantographs measured from the model, the ones it declares and does not give the geometry of) or the reader's format does. The reader is handed in by the plugin's runtime ([method set_mmd_data_reader]). Every MMD file, and every file it includes, is read through the provider it holds ([method set_mmd_provider]): the disk's, [MaszynaFileMmdProvider], until a tool that keeps a vehicle's MMD elsewhere hands in its own.

method.name: get_mmd_provider
method.description: Returns the provider the MMD files are read through.

method.name: load_mmd_data
method.description: Returns the MMD data of the type [param data_path]/[param file_name] in its skin [param livery] - of the vehicle [param vehicle_id] when its MMD names the vehicle; null when the data cannot be read.

method.name: mmd_file_exists
method.description: Returns whether the MMD file at [param abs_path], or a file an MMD includes, is there, as its provider has it.

method.name: mmd_read_file
method.description: Returns what the MMD file at [param abs_path], or a file an MMD includes, says, as its provider has it; empty for none.

method.name: names_vehicle
method.description: Returns whether the MMD at [param abs_mmd_path] names the vehicle it is read for ([code](p1)[/code]): its data is then the vehicle's own, not its type's.

method.name: set_mmd_data_reader
method.description: Sets what reads a vehicle's MMD data - [code](data_path, file_name, livery, vehicle_id: String) -> Resource[/code] - and [param format_version], the version of what it puts into it, raised whenever it changes.

method.name: set_mmd_provider
method.description: Sets where the MMD files are read from - every one, the files they include too; [code]null[/code] for the disk's again ([MaszynaFileMmdProvider]). Read on the vehicles' worker threads.
